keyword_variants_by_market.AU: milestone birthday venues (primary); birthday venues sydney, birthday venues melbourne

audience.notes: Couples in their 30s, AUD 150K+ wedding budgets, planning their own 30th or 40th or hosting a parent's 60th, 70th or 80th. The secondary reader is the parent (or adult child) paying for a 60th or 70th with older guests. Not kids' parties, not hourly hire.

payload.search_intent: Commercial investigation: which kind of venue suits this birthday and guest list, and what to check before booking. SERPs are transactional marketplaces; we win with the guide they do not write.
payload.angle: Choose the venue by the birthday and the guest list, not the photos. Compare private dining rooms, harbour and rooftop spaces, hotel ballrooms, country estates, villas and yachts on guest count, exclusive use, older-guest access, curfew, accommodation and weather plan; name only venues with a live Wedded Wonderland profile; add the weekend-away and abroad version; finish with the questions to ask before paying a deposit and what a Wedded Advisor sources and checks for you.
serp_gaps_to_win: No AU top-3 result explains how to choose a milestone venue; all are marketplaces or single-venue pages.
No result covers access for older guests (stairs, lifts, seating, distance from parking).
No result separates exclusive use from a private room, or covers minimum spend, curfew and noise limits.
No result offers the weekend-away or abroad option with accommodation on site.
No result gives a pre-deposit question list.

outline.h2: What makes a good milestone birthday venue
outline.answers: What should I decide before I look at venues?
must_include: Guest count and who is coming (friends for a 30th or 40th, three generations for a 60th or 70th)
Format: seated dinner, cocktail, long lunch or a weekend
Exclusive use versus a private room in a shared venue
Keyword in the first 100 words of the intro

outline.answers: Which kind of venue suits which birthday?
must_include: Private dining rooms; harbour, rooftop and landmark spaces; hotel ballrooms; wineries and country estates; private villas; yachts
For each: guest band in general terms, what it suits (30th or 40th versus 60th or 70th), one honest trade-off
No capacities or prices unless a venue profile states them
A short comparison table (type, suits, watch for)

must_include: INVISIBLE WORK section
Older guests: step-free access, lifts, seating, drop-off point, bathrooms on the same level

Formatted as a checklist
